visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A dark-clad individual stands before a towering, multi-colored LED Christmas tree topped with a glowing star. To the left, a large illuminated yellow frame features the text 'ZOOLIGHTS Oregon Zoo 2025'. The outdoor setting is night-time, with dim ambient lighting contrasting with the bright displays. (2) A miniature train, decorated with bright red, green, and blue light strips along its roof and sides, travels on tracks through a dark park. On the left, glowing turtle-shaped light sculptures rest on the grass, while the background shows distant building lights and trees. (3) The camera pans across the 'Oregon Zoo' entrance gate, which is bathed in intense blue light from strings of LEDs. Above the sign, a large mural of a tiger and other figures is illuminated in vibrant yellow and orange tones, while people walk by. (4) A young child with a red knit hat and yellow jacket sits inside a blue and gray wagon, looking up at a glowing neon sign in the shape of Oregon with an elephant. The ground is dark pavement, and the background shows zoo fences. (5) The camera moves behind the child in the wagon as they enter a long tunnel constructed from thousands of small, color-changing LED lights. The tunnel glows with blue, purple, and green hues, casting a vibrant light on the ground and passing visitors. (6) A group of people walk down a dark hallway or path where the ceiling is covered in hundreds of tiny, twinkling green lights, resembling fireflies. The walls are dark, and the lighting creates a magical, immersive atmosphere within the enclosed walkway. (7) A large, flat light display depicts an eagle in flight over mountains and a river, created using colorful LED strings. A person in the foreground takes a photo of the display, which is set against a dark night sky in an outdoor plaza. (8) The miniature train, now with red engine lights, pulls several carriages through an outdoor area. The train's movement is captured from a side angle, showing passengers inside and the surrounding dark environment punctuated by distant colored light installations. (9) A wide field is filled with stylized, conical white light trees and glowing white flowers on stalks. Visitors, including a person pulling a wagon, walk along paths between these bright, cold-white displays, which stand out sharply against the black night. (10) An adult male in a gray jacket carries the small child on his shoulders while walking through a dense tunnel of blue and purple lights. The perspective is from behind, showing the tunnel's intense brightness and the silhouettes of other people further ahead.
